_meta.note: Primary experience taxonomy aligned with Tanzania Tourism ‘Things to Do’, remapped for Ramika without duplicate slugs. Legacy ids (wildlife, landscapes, on-the-road) retained for existing package tags. Images matched to subject matter from about_Activities.

items.name: Game drives
items.summary: Guided vehicle safaris through parks and reserves, timed for light, tracks, and wildlife movement.

image.alt: Guides watching from an open safari vehicle on a game drive.

items.name: Climbing / Trekking
items.summary: Mountain climbs and longer highland routes for guests who want the day on foot – from Meru approaches to plateau walks.

image.alt: Guests on a guided forest trek through dense highland woodland.

items.name: Great Migration
items.summary: Follow the seasonal wildebeest and zebra movement across the northern plains, with Serengeti and Ngorongoro at the centre of the story.

image.alt: Young wildebeest on the plains during migration season.

items.name: Bird watching
items.summary: Quiet birding time on lake shores, wetlands, and highland meadows – flamingos, waterbirds, and forest species when the season is right.

image.alt: A guide scanning the lake shore with binoculars for birds.

items.name: Walking / Hiking
items.summary: Guided walks and hikes through forest edges, farms, village paths, and selected park trails.

image.alt: Guides and travellers walking a highland path through tea country.

items.name: Cultural visits
items.summary: Community visits and heritage stops arranged with local hosts – markets, villages, and living culture beside the safari.

image.alt: Guests and guides at the Chief Mkwawa heritage gate.

items.name: Beach relaxation
items.summary: Coast and island shore days after the bush – soft sand, warm water, and unhurried time beside the Indian Ocean or great lakes.

image.alt: Sandy shoreline meeting turquoise water under highland hills.

items.name: Balloon safari
items.summary: Sunrise balloon flights over the plains when conditions and itinerary allow – a quiet aerial view of herds and horizon.

image.alt: Hot air balloon floating above open safari plains at sunrise.

items.name: Chimpanzee watching
items.summary: Forest primate tracking in the west – Gombe and Mahale walks where chimpanzees still shape the day’s pace.

image.alt: Close view of a chimpanzee in green forest.

items.name: Snorkeling / Swimming
items.summary: Reef and shore swimming on the islands and marine edges – clear water, coral gardens, and easy days in the sea.

image.alt: Open crater lake water under a wide sky.

items.name: Wildlife viewing
items.summary: Unhurried wildlife watching across southern parks and beyond.

image.alt: Giraffe and buffalo on open plains.

items.name: Landscapes
items.summary: Highland meadows, waterfalls, and lake shores beyond the usual postcard views.

image.alt: Kalambo Falls cascading into a deep gorge.

items.name: On the road
items.summary: Guided travel between parks through farms, villages, and forest paths.

image.alt: Safari vehicle and guide ready for the road.
